notes.title: Our Life: Argentina and Turkey Currency Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Steam is updating how currencies are handled for Argentina and Turkey and Our Life: Beginnings & Always prices were updated to support that. We've changed the prices for the Argentina Peso and Turkish Lira, and added prices for the new LATAM-USD region and MENA-USD region.

I'm not sure if it will show immediately or if it will take time to fully roll out on Steam, but I do want players to be aware of what's going on.

Thank you for the support!

notes.title: Our Life: Beginnings & Always - The Last Major Update
notes.notes:
Today Our Life version 1.7.1 went live! It fixed the errors reported for Baxter's DLC and added a handful of improvements throughout the entire game. If there are any updates beyond this, they will only be to make minor typo fixes. Our Life has reached a definitive state of completion after almost three years!

Thank you all once more for the kind messages and feedback over the dozens of months of development. It was an incredible experience. And though Our Life: Beginnings & Always won't get further DLCs, GB Patch Games will still be around to make new stories! We hope to see you around again sometime.

And to celebrate finally reaching this point, we had one last promo image made 💚

notes.title: Our Life 1.4.1 Patch!
notes.notes:
We’ve released a bug fix patch for Step 4 of Our Life! These are the patch notes:

•	The errors on the character/Cove creation screens are gone 
•	The game skipping to the wrong Step is resolved
•	Part of the ending CG not being able to appear for some MCs was fixed
•	Some typo/continuity errors in the script were updated
•	A few wrongly set flags were switched
•	And other miscellaneous small tweaks

Older save files might not work this this updated build. 

If you already have the game, it should update automatically.

Thank you very much for all of the feedback. If you’re still running into issues, let us know!

notes.title: Voiced Name DLC Release & Our Life Build 1.1!
notes.notes:
The Voiced Name DLC has released! You can now add preset voiced names to your game build and have Cove say your name of choice aloud. 

Our Life Build 1.1 has also launched! 

We've got a list of changes we've made since OL has initially released:
-Choosing your room in Step 3 now plays like more of a decorating mini-game where you see the background and flip layers on/off, rather than a series of normal choices in the living room.
-New save files will display the name of your MC to help you differentiate saves between multiple playthroughs.
-The body/gender identity series of choices had a bit of an overhaul. One branch was missing and that's been added, but we also updated all the branch choices in some sections to be clearer on what you'll get as a result for picking them.
-The Relationship Screen has easier to use fill bars now and a pop up will ask you to confirm you want a certain relationship type before the game continues. Also, if you fill the bar any amount and go to a new Step the screen will lock the fill amount in place so you can't go lower while still showing it was filled. The bar won't move back to the bottom with no fill amount like before.
-Certain word choices were changed to make them better apply to a wider group of people.
-Some small typos were fixed.


Thank you so much for all of the feedback! We hope you'll enjoy the game even more now with these additions and improvements.

notes.title: Autumn Festival Dev Livestream - Q&A Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Unfortunately, our lead dev who was going to run the live stream during the Steam Autumn festival is under the weather. notes.title: Release Delay to November 16th, 2020
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, because of some serious outside emergencies, Our Life: Beginnings & Always requires a delay. The new date is November 16th, 2020. So, two additional weeks.

Despite that, OL really is coming together. The script is at around 90% completion, the remaining scenes are all fully mapped out, only two new BGs and two CGs are left to do for the art, and so on.

The push back is to ensure we don’t merely get the text into the game and put it out there. We want to make sure we have enough time to have a good spread of partial voice acting clips through each event, be sure extra screens like the gallery won’t crash or display wrong, have a well formatted tutorial, be able to go back and add new alterations to certain scenes, and generally make sure Our Life feels finished rather than simply playable. If we kept the original release date we’d essentially be programming up to the last minute now and would have to sacrifice any polishing that we intended to do. 

We hope that when the game does release it will be worth the wait. Thank you for following this project!

If you'd like to know more about the circumstances we've been working through these past couple months, our social media is the best place for that. Steam updates stick just to the most game-related info.

notes.title: Official Release Date! + Demo Expansion
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Our Life: Beginnings & Always now has its official release date! It will be coming out on Cove's birthday- November 2nd, 2020. That will be for Steps 1-3, the Step 4 epilogue will still be coming out at a later time.


And we’ve just put out the latest update for the public demo ☀


Demo Features:
-A 78,000 word script, up from 67,000 words in the prior version. The complete version of the Step 2 Moment "Wave" was added.  
-A story that starts in childhood and progresses to future points in the characters’ lives. The demo includes multiple scenes from kid-aged and  teen-aged times.
-The main love interest, Cove Holden, changes based on his experiences. In terms of personality, interests, skills, and sense of style. 
-A Custom Cove Creator screen that’s fully functional! You can now customize his appearance, personality, both, or leave it all up to fate. 
-A Character Creation screen where you get to decide all the physical details of the character you play as. The extra option to decorate your MC with earrings has been added to this build (Step 2 only).
-Gorgeous art with a higher amount of variations than before. 
-A lovely 20 track-long OST with a brand new music piece.
-Many, many dozens of choices to determine how your MC reacts/behaves and how scenes play out. Extra options/alterations were put in this build.

Along with all those basics, other miscellaneous improvements were made. Such as beautifying some interface screens, tweaks to prior scripts to make them better, and so on.

We hope new and returning players alike will enjoy the update!

notes.title: Linux Demo Release, Plus Update
notes.notes:
The Our Life demo been re-released to support Linux systems now! We’ve also largely improved/expanded the whole thing.

Demo Details:
-A 67,000 word script, up from 54,000 words in the prior version.
-A story that starts in childhood and progresses to future points in the characters’ lives. The demo includes multiple scenes from kid-aged and teen-aged times.
-The main love interest, Cove Holden, changes based on his experiences. In terms of personality, interests, skills, and sense of style. Major updates were made to the system that controls his personality/interest alterations.
-The Custom Cove Creator screen is up and running, which allows you to design your own look for the LI instead of using the choice-generated version!
-A custom character creation screen where you get to decide all the physical details of your MC. It now has more options than before.
-Many, many dozens of choices to determine how your MC reacts/behaves and how scenes play out. Extra options/alterations were put in this build.
-Gorgeous art with a higher amount of variations now.

We hope you'll enjoy!
